name: Vespid Dynamics Swarm Intelligence Mine SIM-2 'Anthill'
description: A buried anti-personnel mine that, when triggered, launches a swarm of six micro-drones rather than detonating a conventional explosive. The micro-drones emerge from the mine casing, acquire the triggering target using thermal and motion tracking, and pursue it at high speed before detonating their individual shaped charges on contact. The SIM-2 combines the area denial function of a mine with the target-tracking capability of a guided weapon — it cannot be outrun, and it pursues targets who would normally survive by stepping off a conventional mine's pressure plate. Vespid markets it as a 'persistent area denial system with target discrimination.'
specifications:
trigger: Seismic/pressure activation with thermal confirmation
drone count: 6 pursuit micro-drones per mine
individual warhead: 5g shaped charge
pursuit speed: 60 km/h
pursuit range: 200 meters from mine location
flight time: 30 seconds per drone
mine dimensions: 15 cm diameter, 8 cm height
burial depth: 5-10 cm
weight: 1.5 kg per mine
story_hooks: A hiking trail has been seeded with SIM-2 mines and three hikers have been killed by pursuit drones — the mines were planted months ago and the trail has been in use the entire time.
A SIM-2 mine malfunctioned and launched its drones without a target — the six micro-drones are now circling a Tier 2 intersection, armed and seeking anything that moves.
related_entities: Ouroboros Energy PiezoCore LD-5 Pedestrian Kinetic Harvesting Grid

physical_description.visual_profile: A low-profile disc resembling a flattened metal mushroom or sensor node. Deceptively compact and industrial—the kind of object that could pass for buried infrastructure or a forgotten piece of city hardware. The casing has a domed top with subtle panel lines indicating micro-drone deployment seams.
physical_description.dimensions: 150mm diameter, 80mm height. Deployment profile extends approximately 50mm above ground when activated.
physical_description.weight_description: Surprisingly light and dense—approximately 1.5kg feels compact and portable despite the engineering density. Designed for rapid placement rather than sustained carry.
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced polymer composite (HDPE-carbon matrix) with hardened steel internal chassis. Seams indicate pressure-cast construction.
physical_description.finish: Matte olive-drab polymer with brushed steel contact points. Thermal-dissipating coating creates a slightly grainy texture. Minor scuff marks and dirt accumulation typical of field deployment.
physical_description.color_scheme: Weathered olive-green primary with gunmetal gray accent bands around the circumference. Faint VESPID DYNAMICS logo in reflective gray at the dome apex.
physical_description.grip_texture: Not designed for handheld grip—textured polymer exterior provides friction for burial and placement. Deployment handle (if equipped) would be recessed ribbed aluminum.
distinctive_features: Six radial micro-seams arranged in hexagonal pattern across dome—drone emergence points barely visible when closed
Central thermal sensor lens (dark smoky glass, 8mm diameter) positioned at apex
Pressure activation plate recessed beneath 3mm polymer lip
Barely perceptible LED status indicator (red/green) tucked into a recessed pocket—visible only when examining closely
Serial/batch etching along the bottom rim
Faint heat-stress discoloration marks where internal charge chambers sit
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS stamped in sans-serif lettering (12pt) on the lower band. SIM-2 variant designation laser-etched on deployment face. Lot number and manufacturing date (MMYY format) stamped on base plate.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-worn but functional—buried units show soil compaction marks and minor corrosion scoring. Active units display slight thermal discoloration from recent arming. No cosmetic maintenance expected; purely utilitarian appearance. Some units show evidence of hasty placement (mud splatter, partial burial indicators).
